name: Ingrid Karlsson
bio:
Ingrid's journey into motorsport started unexpectedly. Initially trained as a materials engineer, she found herself drawn to the precision and innovation demanded by composite technologies. A pivotal internship at a small racing outfit solidified her passion, showcasing the real-world impact of her work. She joined Team Gtechniq five years ago and has quickly become a reliable member.

Ingrid is known for her methodical approach and unwavering dedication to quality. She believes in understanding the bigger picture, ensuring that every component she works on contributes to the overall performance and safety of the car. Her experience makes her a valuable asset, especially when troubleshooting complex composite failures. She is a firm believer in continuous learning and actively seeks out new techniques and materials to enhance her skills.

physical.hairStyle: Short, layered bob with a side parting
physical.description: Ingrid has a kind face framed by her blonde bob and bright blue eyes.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to a perfect point before starting any task
Keeps a small collection of rocks from different racetracks on her desk
